$comment: Repo-health enforcement declaration. Read by git-toolkit's
against this repo at pre-push (stage [6/6] of pre-push-quality.ps1).
Without this file the gate is REPORT-ONLY: it prints findings and exits 0.
With it, any check whose status is `fail` and whose id is not listed in
acceptedFailures BLOCKS the push. Warnings never block.
Every acceptedFailures entry needs a non-empty `reason`; the gate blocks on a
reason-less entry, on a malformed file, and on this file being untracked, so a
baseline cannot decay into a rubber stamp.
note: Measured at 35a91e1 on 2026-08-25: 31 checks, 28 pass, 3 warn, 0 fail — the cleanest grade in the fleet alongside paperclip. The empty acceptedFailures below is the honest state, not a placeholder: nothing is being tolerated, so any new failing check blocks.
